patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bolt for Business and Personio share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Bolt for Business and Personio share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Bolt for Business only if your buying job matches “Business travel and ground transportation for teams — affiliate partner mapped to HR / ope” rather than Personio's shape. Choose Personio only if your buying job matches “EU mid-market HRIS — Core from €7.60 PEPM (no USD list); CorePro and Recruiting/Payroll ap” rather than Bolt for Business's shape. Workflow advantage: Bolt for Business leans people-platform; Personio leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Bolt for Business and Personio share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Bolt for Business is Business travel and ground transportation for teams — affiliate partner mapped to HR / operations.; Personio is EU mid-market HRIS — Core from €7.60 PEPM (no USD list); CorePro and Recruiting/Payroll apps are quote-led; 12-month annual minimum..
- Workflow coverage skew: Bolt for Business-leaning people-platform vs Personio-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Bolt for Business — Mobility-only — not HRIS or T&E suite; Personio — No USD list price — Core floor is EUR; Apps and CorePro are quotes.

Limitations — Bolt for Business: Mobility-only — not HRIS or T&E suite; Geographic coverage varies; Personio: No USD list price — Core floor is EUR; Apps and CorePro are quotes; Recruiting and full payroll are Apps, not Core.

Poor-fit cases: Bolt for Business is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Mobility-only — not HRIS or T&E suite · Personio is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No USD list price — Core floor is EUR; Apps and CorePro are quotes · Avoid Bolt for Business if you actually need Personio's motion (EU mid-market HRIS — Core from €7.60 PEPM (no USD list); CorePro and Recruiting/)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
